title: Enterprise security ask stitcher and priority simulator for embedded deployments
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build a decisioning layer and lightweight simulator that stitches customer security & compliance asks (SOC2/ISO, HIPAA, GDPR, DPA, vendor questionnaires) into a prioritized intake lane for embedded and private deployment prospects. Goal: reduce manual review time for Security/Legal by ~40% for mid-to-enterprise accounts and provide deterministic routing to: self-serve onramp, SRE/Infra playbook, Dedicated sales path, or Legal escalation. Deliverables: 1) Decision tree mapping of common asks to action lanes; 2) Priority scoring engine prototype and simulator UI for PM/SE review; 3) Evidence-bundling checklist per lane; 4) Integration hooks to intake form, Zendesk, and Console onboarding dashboard. Acceptance criteria: scoring aligns with historical triage outcomes (>=75% precision on past 200 tickets), simulator lets PM/SE tweak weights and observe queue/resolution time delta, and runbook produced for top 3 priority lanes.
updates: 2026-03-02: Kickoff with Security, Legal, SalesEngineering. Gathered canonical ask list: SOC2, ISO27001, HIPAA BAAs, GDPR DPIAs, DPA clauses, and common vendor questionnaire templates (SIG, NIST mapping).

2026-03-04: Prototype scoring schema drafted. We decided on a weighted multi-factor score: data residency impact (40%), customer tier (20%), regulatory scope (20%), technical exposure (20%). Trade-off: higher weight on residency reduces sensitivity to early-stage product-specific asks; will allow override in simulator.

2026-03-06: Design review with UX and SEs. Feedback: simulator must show downstream operational cost estimate (approx GPU hours for on-prem support) and suggested SLA path (Hosted/Dedicated/Private). UX provided mockups. Action: small PRD to capture fields to surface in simulator. Confluence: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ENG/pages/SECU-Intake-Simulator

2026-03-08: Technical spike complete. Engineering (Infra) estimates 3 workdays to build a scoring microservice and 2 days to add a simulator UI behind Console feature flag. Noted complexity around integrating DPA clause templates — Legal to provide canonical text snippets. GitHub spike branch: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pulls/1428

2026-03-09: Pilot dataset prepared from last 250 intake tickets (anonymized). Backend run shows prototype scoring achieves 78% alignment with historical manual routing. Observed failure modes: ambiguous residency asks and security checklists embedded in RFP PDFs. Next: add PDF parsing + rule for residency extraction (label: high effort).

2026-03-10: Stakeholder sync. SalesOps asked for an exportable evidence bundle to attach to vendor responses. Legal flagged requirement to store redacted customer data and audit trail. Marked security_review_required=true. Added follow-ups: implement evidence redaction checklist and add audit-log retention to Console roadmap.
